target.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits at 30s
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators using Codex app-server over `websocket`/`unix` transport would hang forever on `initialize`/RPC when a peer accepted TCP but never completed the WebSocket upgrade. Pending frames never flush and the client never sees a transport exit, so the run cannot fail closed or reconnect.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Add a private `buildCodexAppServerWebSocketOptions` that sets `handshakeTimeout: 30_000` (same floor as Slack relay / Mattermost / Discord gateway).
- Both TCP and Unix upgrade paths consume that builder.
- Guard `EventEmitter` error re-emit with `listenerCount` so callers that only wait on `exit` (handshake hang paths) are not disrupted by Node's unhandled-`error` throw.
- Regressions observe production wiring in source (knip-safe) and prove stalled-handshake exit + `initialize` failure with a short test-only hang floor.

No new config/env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** A Codex app-server endpoint that accepted TCP without completing the websocket handshake could pin `initialize`/RPC forever on that attempt.

**After:** Handshake waits fail closed after 30s (`Opening handshake has timed out` → transport `exit` / client error), so the run can stop or recover instead of hanging.

## Evidence

Compete check (live, before push): no open PR for `createWebSocketTransport` / Codex app-server `handshakeTimeout` (siblings Mattermost `#105553`, Signal `#106471`, ClickClack `#106485`, QQBot `#106484` are different owners).

Head: `ca0c6dbdc9b2adcf44cce506eaf2566a409f1e7c`

```text
$ OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/transport-websocket.test.ts --reporter=verbose

✓ uses a 30s handshakeTimeout matching Slack relay / Mattermost
[codex handshake proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=201 code=1006 handshakeTimeout_ms=200 production_ms=30000
✓ emits exit when the websocket handshake never completes
[codex handshake initialize proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=201 message=initialize transport failed after request write: Opening handshake has timed out
✓ fails initialize when the websocket handshake never completes
Tests  5 passed (5)
```

Negative control (same TCP-accept / never-upgrade fixture): without `handshakeTimeout`, `ws` stays `CONNECTING` and never emits `exit`. With the short test floor, exit arrives in ~201ms; production wiring asserts the 30s constant.
